title: Match3 puzzle tetris attack-like with AI
author: deezymo
selftext:
Made this puzzle game built with Godot + MCP and Claude on VS code

Its for web mobile now but will do it for desktop and native apps later on

Made the first prototype in a few hours, then many hours on debug / polish / improving the UX and everything that actually makes a game looking good.

Browser optimization was definitely the most challenging part ! 

Only endless mode available for now, and no real tuto but a lot coming soon, would love to share any tips while I have been working on this and any feedback appreciated !!

Here to try it out : https://maolty.itch.io/resonance-puzzlegame

comments.author: idog63
comments.body:
Hi pretty cool. The next improvement you should try to do is while the user is dragging a tile have the animation update under their finger / pointer. I just asked claude opus 4.6 for the improvement and it did a great job first try.

I have a similar game, give it a try to see what I mean: [https://zilch.leffsoft.com/](https://zilch.leffsoft.com/)
